purpose: Teach: おこし/悠/パズル/まみれ/井戸/花嫁/ミュージアム/メタル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、修学旅行のお土産、雷おこし、買ってきたんだ、皆に、配ろうよ。
lines.en: Hey Riku — I picked up some kaminari-okoshi from the school trip. Let's hand them out to everyone.
lines.style: Bright, inclusive energy. Quick opening. Eager to involve him in the distribution. No drag in the pacing. Voice rises slightly on the offer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。隣のクラス、悠斗って奴、結構、お洒落だって、評判だぜ、最近。
lines.en: Yeah. So apparently that guy Yuto from the next class over is supposed to be pretty stylish lately.
lines.style: Casual, half-interested delivery. Leans on 'apparently' like he's passing along gossip without really buying it. Shoulder-shrug in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最近、パズル、家でやってる時間、増えてきたよ、私、ストレス解消に、いいの。
lines.en: Lately I've been spending more time doing puzzles at home — it's actually pretty good for stress relief.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly slower pace. Genuine observation, not performing reflection. Quiet certainty in the second half. Settling into the truth of it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活、練習後、泥まみれになるよな、いつも、ユニフォーム、洗濯、大変だぜ。
lines.en: After club practice I'm always completely caked in mud. Getting the uniform clean is a real pain.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware complaint. Matter-of-fact tone. Slight wry humor — not complaining seriously, just noticing the absurdity. Steady rhythm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行、古い民家の井戸、見たよ、リアルで、感動したよ、私、本当に。
lines.en: On the school trip we saw this old farmhouse well — saw it in person, and I was genuinely really moved by it.
lines.style: Animated, leaning forward. Real warmth on the memory. Emphasis on 'genuinely' — defending the sincerity of it. Soft pause before the final affirmation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お姉さん、来年、花嫁になるんだぜ、結婚式、家族で、出るんだ、楽しみ。
lines.en: My older sister's getting married next year. We're all going to the wedding — it's going to be fun.
lines.style: Bright, anticipatory tone. Light lift on 'married.' Genuine excitement that's not trying too hard. Steady, warm delivery without false enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行で、ミュージアム、行ったよ、芸術品、たくさん、すごかったね、皆、感動してた。
lines.en: On the school trip we went to a museum — there were so many artworks. It was incredible. Everyone was really moved.
lines.style: Animated and engaged. Quick, overlapping clauses feel natural not rushed. Wonder in the voice without sounding performative. Shared enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、メタルバンド、聴くんだろ、桜、ライブ、行こうぜ、今度、絶対。
lines.en: You listen to metal bands, right? Sakura, we should definitely go to a live show sometime.
lines.style: Engaging, direct address. Friendly challenge in recognizing her taste. Build energy toward the invitation. Conviction on 'definitely' — genuine enthusiasm, not forced.
